title: Kinematic map of inelastic dark matter consistent with a 248 keV xenon recoil
question: For which (m_chi, delta) is a 248 +- 32 keV Xe recoil kinematically possible on 16 June 2023 (Baxter-2021 SHM), and where does the O1 inelastic spectrum peak relative to 248 keV?
headline_result: Allowed for delta <= 341/387/409 keV at 400/1000/4000 GeV (elastic floor 73 GeV; (400 GeV,350 keV) dash robust), but the O1 spectrum has a form-factor node at 266 keV and peaks at 160-200 keV: 248 keV is above the 98th in-ROI percentile for all delta <= 350 keV and becomes typical only for delta >= 385 keV, within 15 keV of delta_max, where the rate is 1e3-1e4 below delta = 300 keV
model_or_mechanism: inelastic (endothermic) DM, O1 isoscalar, SHM Baxter 2021
confidence: high (kinematics) / medium (spectral position: true energy, simplified efficiency, O1 only)
